newsitem.title: USA: PC stocks rally but Gateway sheds gains.
newsitem.headline: PC stocks rally but Gateway sheds gains.

text.p: Shares of the leading personal computer makers rallied on Wednesday after Gateway 2000 Inc did not pre-announce that its second quarter earnings would be below expectations, as many on Wall Street had feared .
At a PaineWebber conference, Gateway declined to comment on its second quarter business conditions, but added that "it usually comes in like a lamb and goes out like a lion."

Compaq Computer Corp jumped 1-3/4 to 99-3/8, Dell Computer Corp soared 3-11/16 to 108-7/16 and Gateway was up 1-1/4 to 62. But Gateway shed earlier gains, when its shares jumped to an intra-session high of 64-1/2.

On Wednesday rumors swept Wall Street that Gateway would pre-announce an earnings shortfall and, on the heels of similar warnings from Intel Corp and Seagate Technology Inc, new concerns about a PC slowdown fueled a technology sell-off in many PC-related shares.
On Wednesday, a Gateway spokesman said April was weak "as always" and May was better.

Traders said, however, that Gateway did not really allay Wall Street's fears, which was was the principal reason its shares lost their earlier gains. "They didn't really say anything except that it's going by historical standards," one trader said. "But that means they are going to have to have a blow-out June."
